verification.scope: Signature only. Does not authenticate the supplied key or establish object binding; use standalone receiver.

payment.authorization: EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization signed by the customer; the facilitator submits the transaction, so no customer ETH gas is required.

envelope.accepted: Echo of the complete accepts entry from the 402 terms, including maxTimeoutSeconds and extra.

payload.signature: 0x-prefixed 65-byte EIP-3009 signature supplied by the customer signer

payment.settlement: The service verifies then settles each authorization through the facilitator. A signed EIP-3009 authorization settles at most once and the facilitator /settle is idempotent for an identical body, so a retry cannot double-charge. Delivery state is stored by authorization nonce; a replayed authorization returns the delivered Mark.

input_schema.description: The fields the evaluator actually reads from the POST /v1/evaluate request body. This documents existing evaluator behavior; it changes no behavior. The former Railway door is retired (app removed); this deployment is the only door.
input_schema.body: One strict JSON document (UTF-8, no BOM, at most 262144 bytes, at most 64 levels deep): safe integers only (no floats, no -0, no integers beyond +/-2^53-1), no duplicate object keys, well-formed Unicode. The body is either a JSON string (treated as the claim), or a JSON object with the fields below, or a complete WHP-STANDING-SUBMISSION-v1 object.

proposition.claim: string, trimmed non-empty: the proposition examined. Aliases text, prompt, content, statement and proposition are read the same way. Distinct conflicting values across these fields are refused with 400 AMBIGUOUS_INPUT_ALIASES. When no data string is supplied, the claim itself is also the examined material (an explicit, recorded fallback, not a substitution).
proposition.subject: string: mapped to the proposition when no claim alias string is present.
proposition.object.id: non-empty string: the proposition when neither a claim alias nor subject is present.
proposition.object claim: an object-valued claim contributes its first string among text, claim, statement, proposition, id as the proposition.

examination_material.data: string (trimmed non-empty) or object/array: the material the examination reads against the proposition.
examination_material.material: string or object: mapped to data when data is absent. The pre-2026-11-13 nested {"claim": {...}, "material": {...}} shape is accepted through this mapping.

provenance.source: string: a retrievable source reference for the material. Read from source or provenance.source.
provenance.provenance.authority: string: the authority warrant, required for operations crossing the decision boundary (RECOMMEND and above). A top-level warrant string is also read.
provenance.provenance.evidence: array of non-empty strings: verbatim supporting statements.
provenance.provenance.qualifiers: array of non-empty strings: binding qualifiers.

input_schema.requested_operation: string: the operation the caller asks the examination to perform. The gate keeps no fixed list; any operation name is taken as given. Defaults to INFORM when the caller names none. The signed record marks object_binding.operation_origin as caller_supplied or gate_assigned, so a gate default is never indistinguishable from a caller-supplied operation (provenance only; it changes no examination input, outcome or disposition).
optional: nodes [] (signed attestations; a full WHP-STANDING-SUBMISSION-v1 object is also accepted)
refused: A request body with no readable proposition (no claim alias string, no string subject, no object.id) is refused with 400 NOT_EXAMINABLE before any payment movement; the response names the missing objects and no payment is taken.
Malformed or term-mismatched payment envelopes are refused with 402 before any facilitator call.

limits: A configured route is not production activation.
